title: Simplistic — overnight AI agents for small teams
description: A calm, single-accent SaaS landing page for AI agents that run routine workflows overnight and ask before anything risky. The hero is a night scrubber: drag from 22:00 to 07:00 and watch the sky change while each agent's work lands in the log. Includes a pinned four-step story, an agent action dial and one-plan per-agent pricing.
features: Scrubbable night timeline driving sky, moon, sun and clock from motion values
Overnight run log that fills in as jobs cross their timestamps
Trigger picker menu, tool dock and capsule rule switches
Morning review to-do list with strike-through and undo
Liquid action dial for run, skip, pause and edit
Per-agent pricing with elastic stepper and rolling total
Reduced-motion aware, no horizontal scroll at 390px
